description: Comfortable Everyday Riding in a Compact 26-Inch Design The Classic 7-Speed Women's City Bike is designed for riders who want a city bike that feels comfortable, easy to control, and practical for everyday riding. Its lightweight aluminum step-through frame and 26-inch wheels create a compact riding experience that's well suited for neighborhood rides, commuting, running errands, and weekend recreation. The upright riding position encourages a relaxed posture, making everyday cycling feel natural from the moment you get on the bike. Designed to Fit Everyday Riding A city bike should be comfortable to ride and easy to live with. The Classic features a low step-through frame that makes mounting and dismounting simple, especially when making frequent stops around town. Its balanced geometry provides stable handling at both low and moderate speeds, helping riders feel confident whether they're riding through city streets or along local bike paths. The relaxed riding position also helps reduce strain on your back, shoulders, and wrists during longer rides. Compact 26-Inch Wheels for Confident Handling The Classic is built around 26-inch wheels to create a compact bicycle that's easy to maneuver without sacrificing stability. The lower overall ride height gives many riders added confidence when starting, stopping, and riding through traffic or crowded recreational paths. At the same time, the bike remains comfortable and efficient for everyday transportation and casual fitness rides. Smooth 7-Speed Drivetrain The SRAM 7-speed drivetrain provides a practical gear range for changing riding conditions. Whether you're riding flat neighborhood streets, bike paths, or moderate hills, shifting remains smooth and predictable, allowing you to maintain a comfortable cadence throughout your ride. Practical Features for Everyday Use The Classic comes equipped with features that make daily riding more convenient. Full-coverage fenders help reduce water and road spray in wet conditions, while the integrated rear cargo rack provides useful space for groceries, work bags, or other everyday essentials. These practical additions make the bike ready for commuting and daily transportation without requiring additional accessories. Lightweight Aluminum Frame The lightweight aluminum frame combines responsive handling with long-term durability. Its corrosion-resistant construction helps the bike stand up to regular riding while remaining easy to handle when parking, carrying, or transporting the bike. Built for Daily Comfort Every part of the Classic is designed to make everyday riding straightforward and enjoyable. From its upright riding position to its compact frame and practical equipment, the bike is built for riders who value comfort, predictable handling, and dependable performance for everyday transportation and recreation. Ideal For The Classic 7-Speed Women's City Bike is a great choice for: Daily commuting Running errands Neighborhood rides Bike paths Parks and paved recreational trails Weekend recreational riding Riders who prefer a compact, easy-to-handle city bike The Classic is designed for paved roads, bike paths, and hard-packed recreational trails. It is not intended for technical mountain biking, downhill riding, or jumping. Key Features Lightweight aluminum step-through frame Compact 26-inch wheels SRAM 7-speed drivetrain Upright riding position Full-coverage fenders Integrated rear cargo rack Rust-resistant aluminum construction Frame: 26" Light Weight Alloy Frame Frame Sizes: 14" Colors: Beige Fork: Steel Fork Wheels: Alloy 26 x 1.5 36H Tires: Kenda Tire 26 x 1.25 All Black Chain: KMC Z7 Derailleurs: Sram X.3 7 Speed Shift levers: Sram X.3 7 Speed Pedals: Alloy Body Saddle: Comfort Saddle Handlebar: Alloy W:595mm H:66mm Brake set: Alloy Brake Lever / Alloy Caliper Brake Stem: Alloy Weight: 30.2lbs Fits riders from 4 feet 10 inch to 5 feet 6 inch tall. Free Roll Bag included. Wicker / Wire basket are sold separately. The City Commuter Bike Series is, plain and simple, an eye catcher. The classic style evokes a sense of nostalgia that is rare among modern bicycles. This series doesn't sacrifice capability for looks though, as they are also built to meet your needs and make every ride enjoyable and convenient. The Classic 7sp City Bike allows you to do more and do it in style. For storage, this 26in city bike is equipped with a rear-mounted rack and fender. For convenience, the Classic bike has quick-release wheels, a 7-Speed Sram X.3 shifting system, front brakes, rear brakes, and fenders to keep you and your luggage clean and dry.
